parameters.name: num_periods
parameters.description: Number of planning periods in the horizon

parameters.name: period_demand
parameters.description: Required nurse demand in each planning period

parameters.name: shift_start_time
parameters.description: Shift start time for each allowed batch

parameters.name: shift_length_hours
parameters.description: Length of each shift in hours

parameters.name: nurse_categories
parameters.description: Set of nurse categories: regular and contract

parameters.name: regular_hourly_cost
parameters.description: Hourly labor cost for a regular nurse

parameters.name: contract_hourly_cost
parameters.description: Hourly labor cost for a contract nurse

parameters.name: coverage_indicator
parameters.description: Binary coverage indicator equal to 1 if shift batch s covers period t, and 0 otherwise

variables.name: regular_nurses_by_start
variables.description: Number of regular nurses starting in each allowed shift batch

variables.name: contract_nurses_by_start
variables.description: Number of contract nurses starting in each allowed shift batch

variables.name: use_contract_nurses
variables.description: Binary indicator equal to 1 if any contract nurses are used, 0 otherwise

variables.name: total_regular_hires
variables.description: Total number of regular nurses hired across all batches

variables.name: total_contract_hires
variables.description: Total number of contract nurses hired across all batches

variables.name: total_labor_cost
variables.description: Total labor cost of the staffing plan

constraints.name: demand_coverage
constraints.description: For each planning period, total nurse coverage from all allowed shift starts and both nurse categories must meet required demand

constraints.name: nonnegative_integer_regular_starts
constraints.description: Regular nurses started in each allowed batch must be nonnegative integers

constraints.name: nonnegative_integer_contract_starts
constraints.description: Contract nurses started in each allowed batch must be nonnegative integers

constraints.name: contract_usage_binary
constraints.description: Contract usage indicator must be binary

constraints.name: nonnegative_integer_total_regular_hires
constraints.description: Total regular hires must be a nonnegative integer

constraints.name: nonnegative_integer_total_contract_hires
constraints.description: Total contract hires must be a nonnegative integer

constraints.name: nonnegative_total_labor_cost
constraints.description: Total labor cost must be nonnegative

constraints.name: allowed_shift_starts_only
constraints.description: Nurses may start only at allowed shift-start batches

constraints.name: full_shift_once_started
constraints.description: Every assigned nurse works a full shift once started
constraints.formula: a_{t,s}=1 \text{ if shift } s \text{ covers period } t \text{ under shift length } L

constraints.name: regular_and_contract_same_coverage
constraints.description: Regular and contract nurses share the same coverage pattern determined by the overlap indicator and the same shift duration

constraints.name: contract_indicator_status
constraints.description: Contract usage indicator records whether any contract nurses are used

constraints.name: aggregate_hires_regular
constraints.description: Total regular hires represent the aggregate hires across all batches for regular nurses

constraints.name: aggregate_hires_contract
constraints.description: Total contract hires represent the aggregate hires across all batches for contract nurses

constraints.name: total_labor_cost_definition
constraints.description: Total labor cost equals the sum of regular and contract labor costs across all starts

objectives.name: total_labor_cost_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize the total labor cost of the staffing plan while meeting demand in every planning period

final_objective.description: Minimize total labor cost of the staffing plan while meeting demand in every planning period.
